description: Submarine Volcanoes (250k) is a dataset listed in EGDI Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Czech Geological Survey for EuroGeoSurveys. Submarine volcanoes, mapped by various national and regional mapping projects and recovered in the literature (points, lines and polygons). Locally occurrences include their emerged portions. Polygons represent areas larger than 60 hectares. Note: blank areas do not necessarily correspond to no occurrence. Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include EMODnet Central Portal, volcanic_center_250k, features. The listing shows 2025-09-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geology-cz.
